# Exa

AI-focused web search for agents: neural and keyword search, find pages similar to a URL, fetch page contents, get answers with citations, and manage monitors, agent runs, batches and websets (searches, enrichments, items, imports, webhooks and events).

**Interface:** OpenAPI plus two hand-written tools. Exa's own "Exa Public API" 2.0.0 document, https://api.exa.ai/openapi.json (also published at https://exa.ai/docs/exa-spec.yaml), served against https://api.exa.ai. 64 tools are generated live from it, including the JSON form of `POST /search`, `POST /answer` and the agent-run endpoints, which the document also offers as server-sent events. `custom.search` and `custom.answer` remain as simpler forms that call those two endpoints with `stream: false` and return plain JSON. Generated tools live under `api.*`, the custom ones under `custom.*`. Search, contents, find-similar and answer are reads that Exa models as POST; they are queries and run without approval, though they spend credits. Every other POST, PUT, DELETE and PATCH (websets, monitors, imports, batches, agent runs and webhooks) is a mutation and asks for approval.

**Auth:** API key. Create one in the Exa dashboard at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys; it is sent in the `x-api-key` header (Exa also accepts it as a Bearer token). Exa has no OAuth for user-created apps, so no OAuth method is offered.

**Icon:** the "E" mark from Exa's official logo (https://exa.ai/images/logo/exa-logo-blue.svg, linked from https://exa.ai/brand), cropped from the wordmark. Simple Icons has no Exa entry.

**Known gaps:** Server-sent-event responses are not exposed; their JSON forms are. Exa also publishes a public, unauthenticated remote MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp (web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa); it is not used because the OpenAPI document covers far more. The health check reads `GET /v0/teams/me` on the Websets server (`https://api.exa.ai/websets`), as the document's operation-level `servers` entry declares, and checks only the response status: 401 means the key was refused, 403 a refusal without a stated reason, 429 and 5xx that Exa is unavailable, and anything else that the key could not be verified.
